name: aes_inverse_scan
description: Find AES-128 and AES-256 key schedules stored as a decryption routine keeps them (InvMixColumns on the middle rounds, either round order, word bytes kept or reversed) in a file or memory image, at every byte alignment. A key goes to a private file in out_dir, never to the answer: it gives offset, layout, the key's sha256. A hit is a lead. Not AES-192 or the plain layout (aes_schedule_scan).

path.description: The file or memory image to scan (read only)

out_dir.description: Where the key files and the whole result go, inside the run directory and not under inputs/ (default work/quarantine/<agent>/aes_inverse_scan, which a handover package leaves in the sandbox; anywhere else, and a job's other outputs, travel with it unless the hit is a sensitive ledger entry citing key_file, or the job ran with secret_output)

start.description: First byte to test (default 0). A schedule is reported by where it starts, so successive windows never lose or double one

length.description: How many bytes to test from start (default: to the end of the file)

budget_seconds.description: Stop at a chunk boundary after this long (at most 110) and say complete=false with next_start; call again with start=next_start (default 90)
